name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
One day, I will create a legendary hammer. A hammer fit for a Warchief!

It is my life's work, adventurer. My passion. I recognize that you have the potential to be among us, one of us - a weaponsmith. I am the one that can help you harness that potential.

A simple task is all that you must complete. Simple for one of your exceptional skill.
narrative.objectives: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is the final step before you begin your new career as a weaponsmith, adventurer. Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. Otherwise, prepare to be consumed by knowledge!
narrative.requestItemsText: For the glory of the Horde!
